title: Contribute segmented control and stat tile to bricks, then use them
goal: The two generic pieces bricks lacks are added to bricks by PRs in voidbrain/bricks, released, and the client switches to them
acceptance: bricks PR 'segmented control' (radio group in a fieldset with a hidden legend; used for mode and chart range) and bricks PR 'stat tile' (label, value, unit, tone) are merged in voidbrain/bricks under that repo's own rules and named here with their numbers
The client pins the release that has them and replaces .segmented and the probe and tank tiles
Any piece F-020-T01 found missing beyond these two is listed for the owner, not added silently
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A bricks component that cannot take Grover's look through the theme goes to bricks as a proposal, never a local override

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: two small components with specs in bricks plus a swap here; bricks review and release waits included. Not a measurement.
